name: Thinking Machines
short: Thinking Machines Lab, the frontier lab behind Inkling — an Apache-2.0 multimodal MoE you fine-tune and playground-test on its Tinker API (inference also runs on third-party hosts).

plans.name: Open weights
plans.notes: Apache-2.0 Inkling weights are free to download and self-host.

plans.name: Tinker (fine-tuning + playground)
plans.notes: Tinker meters training/inference compute for fine-tuning and testing Inkling; hosted inference also available via third-party providers.
